params.text:
Elementary guruhlar, bugun yana oila mavzusi: my, our, their va 's.
Besh savol, oxirgisiga kelib biroz qiyinlashadi. Qani, kim hammasini topadi? 🙂

params.question: My uncle's son is my ___.
params.explanation: Amaki yoki tog'aning o'g'li cousin bo'ladi. Nephew esa aka-uka yoki opa-singilning o'g'li, ya'ni jiyan.

params.question: My sister and I share a room. ___ room is small but very cosy.
params.explanation: Ot oldidan egalik so'zi keladi: our room. Ours otsiz ishlatiladi (The room is ours), we va us esa oddiy olmoshlar.

params.question:
A: ___ old is your grandfather?
B: He's seventy-two.
params.explanation: Yoshni so'raganda How old ishlatamiz: How old is he? What old degan savol ingliz tilida yo'q.

params.question: Choose the correct sentence.
params.explanation: Ismga 's qo'shiladi va oldidan the qo'yilmaydi: Rustam's wife, ya'ni Rustamning xotini.

params.question: Which sentence has a mistake?
options: My brothers' names are Ali and Bobur.
The womens' room is on the left.
My wife's parents live in Navoi.
params.explanation: Women ko'plik shakli, lekin s bilan tugamaydi, shuning uchun women's bo'ladi. Brothers' esa to'g'ri, chunki brothers s bilan tugaydi.
